issues.title: Truncated Context / Missing Files
issues.why: The provided context is truncated at 120KB, cutting off the end of the 'Complete Workflow Reference' and missing several root files (03-10, 11-technical-interface) referenced in the overview.
issues.fix: Provide the full content of all files listed in the Feature Inventory, especially the technical interface contract.

issues.title: Race Condition in SHA Cache Pattern
issues.why: The SHA-deduplication pattern in 01-ci-pipeline.md relies on a cache lookup that might be stale if multiple PRs are merged rapidly, potentially leading to 'green' builds on broken code if the cache key collision occurs.
issues.fix: Add a 'force-run' label check or include the parent commit SHA in the cache key to ensure uniqueness.

issues.title: Ambiguous Slot Resolution
issues.why: The module uses 'slot collisions' (e.g., 01-ci-pipeline.md vs 01-browser-extension-deploy/). While AC-09 explains this, a mediocre AI might still struggle with path resolution without explicit file extensions in all cross-refs.
issues.fix: Enforce absolute-style relative paths (./path/to/file.md) for all internal cross-references.
